2 CORAM: HON'BLE MR JUSTICE HEMANT CHANDANGOUDAR  -3-  NC: 2024:KHC:50001  WP No. 8277 of 2024  ORAL ORDER The respondent No.5 issued a tender notification dated 22.12.2023 inviting bids for providing canteen services for a period of one year. In response to the tender document, the petitioner,
respondent No.9, and 23 other bidders submitted their bids. The technical bid of the petitioner was rejected by respondent No.6, citing non-compliance with Clause 3(vii) of the Additional Terms and Conditions. Consequently, the bids of the other participants were considered, and the financial bid of respondent No.9 was identified as the lowest (L1). Respondent No.9 was declared the successful bidder and has been awarded the contract to operate the canteen, which he has been running since 01.06.2024 in accordance with the contract terms. 
2. The learned counsel for the petitioner contends that the license from the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) is required to be furnished only after the contract is awarded. 
Therefore, the rejection of the petitioner's technical bid is contrary to the Additional Terms and Conditions of the tender document. He further asserts that a coordinate bench of this Court, in W.P.
No.23396/2023 (decided on 27.01.2023), had granted the petitioner liberty to participate in the ensuing tender. It was directed that the petitioner's bid should be considered without being influenced by the allegations made in the previous petition and NC: 2024:KHC:50001 objections. 
Therefore, the rejection of the technical bid on the same set of facts is impermissible. 
3. Sri Shanthi Bhushan, learned Deputy Solicitor General of India, representing respondents No.1 to 8, argued that under Clause 3(vii) of the Additional Terms and Conditions, the petitioner was required to furnish an FSSAI license for seven products. However, the petitioner submitted a license for only one product and, therefore, did not satisfy the requirement. Consequently, the rejection of the petitioner's technical bid is justified. 
4. The arguments of the learned counsel for both parties have been duly considered. 
5. Clause 3(vii) of the Additional Terms and Conditions stipulates that the bidder must furnish an FSSAI license covering the seven products listed therein. Additionally, the successful bidder must produce an FSSAI certificate from the local office within fifteen days to continue operating the canteen at PTC Mysuru. 
6. In the present case, the petitioner submitted an FSSAI license for only one product, not for all seven products as required by Clause 3(vii). Furthermore, the license submitted was in the name of M/s. Bank Note Paper Mills NC: 2024:KHC:50001 India Pvt. Ltd., Note Mudran Nagar, Mysuru,
and not in the petitioner's name. 
Harin Kumar Hp vs Union Of India on 4 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/149610276/
3 7. The respondents No.1 to 8, in their statement of objections, have asserted that respondent No.9 satisfied all the terms and conditions of the tender document and quoted the lowest price. 
Considering that respondent No.9 is providing food services in 11 Central Government departments,
including IITs and five Central Government institutions, serving a total of 10,860 students, with financial implications of Rs.30.6 crores, the contract was awarded to respondent No.9.
8. Therefore, the rejection of the petitioner's technical bid is in conformity with the Additional Terms and Conditions of the tender document. The contract awarded to respondent No.9 is also consistent with the tender document's requirements. Hence, no illegality is found in the rejection of the petitioner's technical bid. 
9. Accordingly, I pass the following:
ORDER i) The petition stands dismissed.
ii) It is needless to state that in the event, the petitioner submits his bid in ensuing tender, the respondents No.1 to 8 are obligated to consider the same strictly in NC:
2024:KHC:50001 accordance with the terms and conditions of the tender document without being influenced by any of the observations made in this order or rejection of his bid under the impugned tender document. 
Sd/-
